name: Small Ships 2.0.0 [Forge - 1.20.1]
changelog:
# SmallShips 2.0.0

## Added
- New ships: Galleon, Caravel, Dhow
- Dockyard: build, upgrade and repair ships
- Datapack-driven dockyard recipes
- Wind-based sailing with a wind profile per ship
- Ship upgrades: Iron Scantlings, Copper Plating, Cotton Sails
- Ammo types: Cannonball, Chain Shot, Grape Shot (mouse wheel to select, HUD shows available ammo)
- Ground Cannon
- Ramming
- Sinking animations and wood debris on cannon impact
- Epic Knights shield support
- Gunner seats: click a cannon to man it
- Ship inventory panel to detach cannons, banners and shields
- Sail patching with string and iron nuggets
- Control tips when boarding a ship
- Hoppers can access the ship's hold
- NPCs leave the deck onto nearby land when the ship lies still
- Addon API (ship registry) for ship-addon mods
- Update checker

## Improved
- Multipart hitboxes: decks are walkable
- Cannon aiming: accurate, camera sits on the barrel
- Seating: players get the helm first, then the nearest free seat

## Fixed
- Creative tab disabled by default on Forge
- Freshly spawned ships not walkable
- Passengers damaging their own ship
- Bubble columns affecting ships
- Ship turning on its own after the driver dismounts
- Cargo visuals out of sync with multi-page inventories

## Config
- Split into server and client config; server values sync to clients
- Ship attributes apply live to existing ships
- `dockyardBuildableShips` whitelist (empty = all ships)
- Per-ship upgrade costs
- `updateCheckerEnable` toggle
